title: v5.6 gate. CTRL with seasonal-wildlife enabled and its own spring roster, resident groups and migratory coupling on, ecology on versus off. No harness manipulation of the pool or the units: the tool does everything. Sixty thousand ticks. Ecology on should kill prey beside the coupled predators (E11c: 19 of 19 with the relation written, 0 of 14 without); ecology off should look like E11c's no-lever arm.
fork: Does the shipped v5.6 do what the rig's lever did: relation written on the cadence, departed slots cleared, predators nudged to prey.

predictions.expects: ecology on: at least one wild prey death within the run in 3 of 3; ecology off: 0 of 3 (predator-on-predator deaths do not count)
ecology on kills no prey, or the groups status shows 0 pairs written or a Lua error

kill_criterion: prey deaths in the on arm and none in the off arm ships v5.6; anything else does not
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: ecology_on
pre: local ok,err=pcall(dfhack.run_command,'seasonal-wildlife','groups','on'); print('seasonal-wildlife groups on ->', tostring(ok), tostring(err))
local ok,err=pcall(dfhack.run_command,'seasonal-wildlife','groups','coupling','on'); print('seasonal-wildlife groups coupling on ->', tostring(ok), tostring(err))
local ok,err=pcall(dfhack.run_command,'seasonal-wildlife','groups','ecology','on'); print('seasonal-wildlife groups ecology on ->', tostring(ok), tostring(err))

arms.name: ecology_off
pre: local ok,err=pcall(dfhack.run_command,'seasonal-wildlife','groups','on'); print('seasonal-wildlife groups on ->', tostring(ok), tostring(err))
local ok,err=pcall(dfhack.run_command,'seasonal-wildlife','groups','coupling','on'); print('seasonal-wildlife groups coupling on ->', tostring(ok), tostring(err))
local ok,err=pcall(dfhack.run_command,'seasonal-wildlife','groups','ecology','off'); print('seasonal-wildlife groups ecology off ->', tostring(ok), tostring(err))
